question.text:
Calculate the order of leaf ( $P_{\text {leaf }}$ ) and non leaf (P) nodes of a $B^{+}$tree based on the information given below.
Search key field = $12$ field
Record pointer = $10$ bytes
Block pointer $=8$ bytes
Block size $=1 \mathrm{~KB}$

  1. $P_{\text {leaf }}=51 \& \mathrm{p}=46$
     
  2. $P_{\text {leaf }}=47 \& \mathrm{p}=52$
     
  3. $P_{\text {leaf }}=46 \& \mathrm{p}=51$
     
  4. $P_{\text {leaf }}=52 \& \mathrm{p}=47$
question.subject: Databases

question.text:
Consider a relation R(A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J) with functional dependencies:

$$
\mathrm{AB} \rightarrow \mathrm{C}, \mathrm{BD} \rightarrow \mathrm{EF}, \mathrm{AD} \rightarrow \mathrm{GH}, \mathrm{~A} \rightarrow \mathrm{I}, \mathrm{H} \rightarrow \mathrm{~J} .
$$

Which of the following is a candidate key for R ?
A) $A B D$
B) $A B D H$
C) $A D$
D) $A B D I$
question.subject: Databases

question.text:

  1. $K^2$
     
  2. $K-1$
     
  3. $K+1$
     
  4. $\sqrt{K}$

question.text:
Consider the join of a relation $R$ with a relation $S$. If $R$ has $m$ tuples and $S$ has $n$ tuples then the maximum and minimum sizes of the join respectively are

  1. $m+n$ and $0$
     
  2. $m n$ and $0$
     
  3. $m+n$ and $|m-n|$
     
  4. $m n$ and $m+n$

question.text:
Which functional dependency holds in given relation $\mathrm{R}(\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}, \mathrm{C})$ and why?  
$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}
\hline \mathbf{A} & \mathbf{B} & \mathbf{C} \\
\hline 7 & 1 & 8 \\
\hline 7 & 2 & 5 \\
\hline 7 & 3 & 5 \\
\hline 5 & 8 & 8 \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$

  1. $\mathrm{AB} \rightarrow \mathrm{C}$    $\&\&$    $\mathrm{C} \rightarrow \mathrm{B}$
     
  2. $\mathrm{BC} \rightarrow \mathrm{A}$    $\&\&$    $\mathrm{B} \rightarrow \mathrm{C}$
     
  3. $\mathrm{BC} \rightarrow \mathrm{A}$    $\&\&$    $\mathrm{A} \rightarrow \mathrm{C}$
     
  4. $\mathrm{AC} \rightarrow \mathrm{B}$    $\&\&$    $\mathrm{B} \rightarrow \mathrm{C}$
